desc:
☀️ Welcome to Highland Park! A city made for you to roleplay, hang out, and explore!
✨ Tell your story with a large selection of diverse houses, nice cars, roleplay items, and dress up options!

🏙️ Over 60+ Unique Roleplay Locations
🏫 Enroll in Highland Park High School
🐶 Save Sick Pets at the Vet Clinic
💄 Shop for Makeup and Create New Stylish Looks
🏥 Perform Life Saving Surgery at the Hospital
💰 Rob the Bank and Escape with Untold Riches
👮 Join the Police Force and Stop Crime
🦸 Become a Hero or a Villian with a Secret Lair
& So Much More, You Can't Even Imagine!

Genres: Roleplay, Town and City, Hangout, Dress Up
